# Machine-First Design Agent Wiki
> Curated High-Performance UI Registries & Anti-Slop Safeguards

## System Architecture & Endpoints
- Registry Index: /r/registry.json
- Component Items: /r/[name].json
- Raw Markdown Docs: /raw/components/[slug]
- MCP Server: npx @design-wiki/mcp

## Available Registry Components (27 verified zero-slop items)

### Category: ui:block
- [bento-grid](/r/bento-grid.json): Multi-pane asymmetrical layout grid with responsive column spans and structural borders. (Variance: 7, Motion: 3, Density: 6)
  - Tags: lucide-react, bento-grid, tailwind-v4, layout-block, asymmetry, marketing
  - Dependencies: lucide-react, clsx, tailwind-merge
  - Install: npx shadcn@latest add http://localhost:3000/r/bento-grid.json
- [hero-section](/r/hero-section.json): Editorial SaaS hero section featuring typography discipline, badge pill, and active CTA. (Variance: 5, Motion: 2, Density: 5)
  - Tags: lucide-react, tailwind-v4, accessible, layout-block, hero, marketing, typography, block
  - Dependencies: lucide-react, clsx, tailwind-merge
  - Install: npx shadcn@latest add http://localhost:3000/r/hero-section.json
- [pricing-table](/r/pricing-table.json): Multi-tier pricing matrix with monthly/annual toggle and clear feature checkmarks. (Variance: 4, Motion: 3, Density: 7)
  - Tags: lucide-react, bento-grid, tailwind-v4, accessible, layout-block, brutalist, pricing, saas, marketing, interactive-toggle
